TypeSignature.Value: .class public auto ansi sealed BuildVersionCodesFull extends System.Enum

Docs.summary: Enumeration of the currently known SDK major and minor version codes. The numbers increase for every release, and are guaranteed to be ordered by the release date of each release. The actual values should be considered an implementation detail, and the current encoding scheme may change in the future.
